## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M5 - Anomaly Detection.

## Technical Scope

- Python-based command-line and programmatic integration
- Dataset ingestion from structured formats such as JSON and CSV
- Pipeline stages include preparation, prompt construction, LLM analysis, and aggregation
- Supports human-in-the-loop review for flagged records
- Designed for validation and monitoring, not final automated decision making

## Run Guidance

python -m <module_entry> --input <dataset> --output <annotated_dataset>

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
